mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the prior month) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (INDPRO > 105.0 and CPIAUCSL monthly change < 2.5%), a higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and CPIAUCSL monthly change < 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above $490 billion (RSAFS > 490000) indicates robust consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of corporate revenue growth and thus positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 490000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 1.5%) signals a favorable economic environment for equities, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 1.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a tightening labor market, which is associated with rising wages and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above $17,000 billion (GDPC1 > 17000) indicates robust economic expansion, which is a leading indicator of strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 17000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
